decisions.reason: As a core underground equipment line with strong engineering and service fit, management would likely keep it unless clear multi-year results showed a shortfall below aspiration, which is not established here.

The construction site dumper looks more peripheral and likely faces tougher comparison with established rivals, so after several years of uncertainty a boundedly rational firm would tend to reallocate resources if results seem below aspiration.

The inclined furniture lift is a niche but capability-consistent lifting product, and absent strong evidence of underperformance the firm would use available slack to continue it while monitoring demand.

The inclined building material lift fits the firm's lifting and construction applications well, so management would likely keep it because its strategic fit and service synergies support patience under uncertainty.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is narrower and more resource-intensive than the basic lift lines, so if its results have not clearly met aspirations the firm would likely simplify the range and redeploy resources.
